introduction: Follow the smith's material request and the linked Church requests. Exact accepted returns, current preparation, actual passage and later rewards each have their own meaning.
orientation: The abandoned mines and undead tomb contain the smith's request, hidden passages, a surviving dwarven camp and Kelek's crypt. This journal also includes two requests from people in the Church of the Eternal Dusk.

Ask the duergar smith about mithril. Bring one chunk of mithril and one smithy hammer loose together for his jet black cloak with mithril streaks. His reward does not require defeating Kelek or repairing the forge.

The mithril chunk is declared at the bottom of a mine shaft. A zombie mountain dwarf soldier is declared wielding the smithy hammer. Supplied exact materials also fit the return; possession alone does not prove personal recovery.

The Church bishop is in his meditation room. Ask bishop initiation. He accepts the cardinal's skull and spine for coins and experience. His promises and threats do not themselves record membership or expulsion.

A captive paladin in the Church's northern cell accepts troll ears, an ogre skull and a duergar hand together. The sources are declared in the southern cell. The resulting note can go to the field general at the paladin encampment for a separate reward.

The Church passage above the interrogation area is magically sealed. Saying blasphemy there can reveal and unlock it, but you must still open the door and move through. The jailor's dark iron key serves the cell doors; a successful proof return does not establish a rescue or escort.

Search and open the hidden routes to the smithy and dwarven camp when your character can. The lich guarding the crypt carries a crystalline key that breaks after unlocking. Actual passage and return differ from current key possession.

The dwarven cleric carries the Deliverer, whose wielded combat effect targets undead foes. Kelek carries an epic node with its own touch reward process. Neither combat equipment nor a boss death substitutes for one of these item returns.

Reset declarations are leads rather than guaranteed stock. Daily rollover does not replenish materials. New discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting.
